data.one_liner: An easy-to-use confirm dialog widget for Flutter with a JS-like syntax.
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple function call to display a confirmation dialog matching the app's theme. It returns a Future resolving to a boolean depending on whether the user pressed OK or Cancel.
use_when: You need a quick confirmation dialog with minimal boilerplate.
You want a JS-like confirm experience in Flutter.
avoid_when: You require a complex multi-step wizard or custom non-standard dialog layouts.
You manage dialog state through a rigid declarative routing state machine.
strengths: Follows app's theme out of the box.
weaknesses: Limited to a basic confirmation flow with standard buttons.
Minimal customizability beyond basic title, content, and button text widgets.
